media.prompt: Macro photograph of a dew-covered green leaf lit by a warm golden backlight against a near-black background, tiny glowing bokeh, ultra detailed

what: Foundation for creative freedom. Diverse aesthetics with exceptional photorealistic quality; ideal for fine-tuning; responsive to negative prompts; high generation diversity.
dossier:
Speed and Efficiency: When sub-second inference latency is required on enterprise GPUs or when running on consumer devices with 16GB VRAM, use Z-Image-Turbo [MODEL.md].
   Photorealism and Text Rendering: When the task requires photorealistic image generation or accurate bilingual text rendering (English and Chinese), use Z-Image-Turbo [MODEL.md].
   Creative Control and Diversity: When high-quality generation, rich aesthetics, strong diversity, and controllability are needed, use Z-Image [MODEL.md].
   Fine-Tuning and Development: When a base model is required for community fine-tuning, LoRA training, or structural conditioning (ControlNet), use Z-Image or Z-Image-Omni-Base [MODEL.md].
